answer: Bonded stake with decaying slash: each new identity posts a deposit that burns like an ember if its attestations diverge from the median peer set. A raven-style reputation graph only trusts edges aged past one epoch, so cloned identities cannot borrow standing overnight. Referral vine depth is capped at one hop and kin-linked clones earn zero, raising the marginal cost of a Sybil swarm linearly with headcount rather than with clever naming.
